Automated translation (refer to source for accuracy)

Join the 13th Hidaka Kawasemi-no-Sato Two-Day Walk (November 28–29, Reiwa 8) to earn Sugo-Ashi stamps (special two-day walk seals).

You can earn one stamp per day regardless of which course you take. Please bring your Sugo-Ashi handbook (available at the venue if needed).

Stamps are issued at the Hanno Walking Club booth in Binchotan Park (the main venue at 125–2 Takara-Koma Hongo, Hidaka City).

Participants who collect 5 or more Sugo-Ashi stamps at Hanno City events within the same fiscal year receive a special prize. (Eligibility: Hanno City residents, employees, and students only.)

Source (Japanese): https://www.city.hanno.lg.jp/soshikikarasagasu/kenkohukusibu/hokencenter/10590.html
